proposition: The charge of ṣūfīgarī was probably meant to tie Ibn Turka to the subversive Ḥurūfiyya rather than to Sufism in general; MK's inference (‘no doubt meant’).

mediation.who: the accusation of ṣūfīgarī before Shāhrukh
Ibn Turka, Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I, addressed to Shāhrukh
mediation.note: the charge is known only from his own answer to it
'no doubt meant' is MK's inference about the accusers' intent
